raw_comment:
What do you notice?
I notice that the places with the most drought tend to be placed mostly in the middle of the United States. 

What do you wonder?
I wonder why in places like Montana and Ohio there is an extreme amount of drought that is not following the pattern of being in the center of America? Are there different factors relating to nature, or to humans? 

How does this relate to you and your community?
This relates to me and my community because when the air is very dry it impacts the everyday life of humans and for Michigan it shows moderate drought, so when a heavy drought hits, it can negatively affect breathing, animals, human exercise.  

“Mother Nature has no tears left to cry”
